figures.Fig18.13: Sex determination in animals. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch18-fig-sex-systems (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: For birds the book prints 'When a Y carrying egg is fertilized by the sperm, offspring is female'; in the ZW-ZZ system it is a W-carrying egg. The lesson corrects it with a note, flagged.
The end of the XX-XY paragraph ('carry one Y chromosome. If a sperm with X ...') is displaced by the page layout to below the ZW paragraph (PDF 104); it is read in order.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content. Our explanations, notes on the print, self-check questions with their answers, the recap, 3D models and figures the book does not print are in the Roman Urdu lesson only; where the book's own Quick Check or Brain Teaser questions are given, the English lesson lists them without answers.
